title: Dynamic dependence and predictability between volume and return of non-fungible tokens (NFTs): the roles of market factors and geopolitical risks
summary: The paper studies the volume–return relationship for the overall NFT market and three sub-markets (Cryptokitties, Cryptopunks and Decentraland). It finds significant dependence between NFT return and volume, weakest for Cryptopunks.
keyFindings: NFT returns and trading volume show significant dependence, weakest for Cryptopunks.
Under extreme market conditions, uncertainty in equity, gold and oil markets, business conditions and geopolitical risks predict returns, varying by sub-market.
Increases in Bitcoin prices reduce NFT market returns in all cases.
methods: Quantile cross-spectral coherency and quantile regression.
